[0xa6987c] is loaded into ebx and overwritten by [esi+0xe] before any use (not an input). [0xa69880] = the mode passed in edx: 'cmp edx,2; jne' (2 drawn often) and, through the handler, the selector of 0x53dbbc (which clamps >= 10 to 9), so 0..12 plus large/negative values.
